descriptionInUI: Lets a player call a ballistic missile strike from a friendly launcher (Scud-B, 9K720 Iskander, ATACMS and the like) onto a marker on the F10 map. Put a marker on the target, then pick the battery, the marker and the number of rounds from the F10 radio menu, Ballistic Missile Strike. A battery refuses a target outside its range or inside its minimum range, and says why. The launchers are the campaign's own units, so a destroyed launcher fires nothing and rounds are not replaced in the mission. Inert when your side has no launcher.

specificOptions.nameInUI: Give up if no round is fired within (s)
